SELF_AUDIT.SCALABILITY_CURVE: GlobalQualityWeight is consumed during offline bake. Below 0.3, ResolveLod1Ratio and ResolveLod2Ratio continuously reduce triangle density with math.smoothstep, ResolveDecimationWindow collapses to one source-triangle sample per deterministic partition, LOD thresholds are compressed, depth culling is more aggressive, and ResolvePrimitiveTolerance raises primitive acceptance so more assets collapse to Box/Sphere colliders. Between 0.4 and 0.7, ratios, partition-local saliency, and thresholds hold middle residency while deterministic budgets remain bounded. At 1.0, LOD0/LOD1 residency extends and the decimator scans up to seven candidates inside each output triangle's source partition to preserve larger silhouette triangles without overlapping neighboring partitions; saved PhysX cost buys richer visual mesh residency, not heavier collision. No IsLowEndHardware branch exists.

SELF_AUDIT.DEAR_LIE_CONFIRMATION: Before: concave source-mesh collision approaches O(T) triangle contact/cooking complexity. After: sphere/box is O(1), fallback convex collision is bounded to V support points where 8 <= V <= 32; offline face discovery is capped to O(V^3) but emitted faces are plane-deduped and fan-triangulated before MeshCollider import.
